adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh flow always POSTs to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` directly and does not use the new `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` helper that routes via `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` when credential sharing is enabled (unlike the other integrations changed in this diff). Additionally, it calls `parseRefreshTokenResponse(accessTokenJson, salesforceTokenSchema)`, but `parseRefreshTokenResponse` switches to `minimumTokenResponseSchema` whenever `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is set, which can strip non-minimum fields like `instance_url`. The DB update then persists `key: { ...accessTokenParsed.data, refresh_token: ... }`, so `instance_url` may be lost under those env conditions, which would break later code expecting `ExtendedTokenResponse` (includes `instance_url`).
